summary: No movement: 280 tier letters re-parsed, 0 moves; every metric source frozen upstream. Archon raid pages rebuilt to S2 chrome but publish 0 tiers, n=1-2. 3 videos queued.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-340 KB. Parsed from <table class="tier-list"> rows (first <td> = the tier letter) with each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split at a space - the rule that keeps the six two-word-class specs matchable. Per-page counts printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6=40 roster shape BEFORE merging: raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, and apply-ratings re-applied them to prove the match (git diff on data/specs.json came back empty). ZERO tier moves, raid and M+ alike. Consistent with the page dates, which are byte-identical to this morning's run and agree 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json (raid DPS 2026-08-16, raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16), so nothing rebuilt upstream today. Era read from each page's own title AND body, not a substring count: four titles self-identify Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and two carry a stale-era title over a Season-2 body - the raid HEALER page ("Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight", 21 Season-2 mentions against 6 Season-1) and the raid DPS page ("Midnight (12.1)", 54 against 14). Body over title, the blue-tracker precedent; seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and no value changed, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to do. published re-read per page, not carried forward, and unchanged. NOTE ON THE DATE: this is the second run of 2026-08-21 (the first landed 11:00Z), so the page snapshots were already stamped today and a same-day run cannot advance them - previousAsOf equals newAsOf for that reason, not because a fetch was skipped.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 159/166 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = the letter, img alt = "Spec Class" looked up whole): 40 raid + 40 M+ rows, 0 roster-matching unmatched, 0 tier moves. The M+ page carries 8 tier blocks - 4 spec tiers plus 4 dungeon-difficulty blocks - and the extras were rejected by ROSTER MATCH rather than by position: King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs and the Method logo all fail to map, which is exactly the intended behaviour. Era verified from the ranking body, not the title: the raid page reads "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" and "written in collaboration with Method raiders", the M+ page reads "Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2" under Tactyks' byline, and the dungeon pool listed is the Season-2 pool. seasonVerified stays s2 on both; unchanged, so nothing for freeze-season.mjs. Method publishes no dateModified and no in-body "last updated" line, so there is no published value to record for either page - unchanged from prior runs. Second run of 2026-08-21, so the snapshots were already at today's date and could not advance.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-337 KB. Parsed by unescaping backslash-slash to slash across the WHOLE document FIRST and then searching for [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list], selecting the block with the most [spec-badge=] hits rather than anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( - the anchor that returned 0 rows off the raid-healer decoy in the 08-01 incident. One block per page; badge counts 27/7/6 raid and 27/7/6 M+ = 80, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Tier labels parsed with tolerant whitespace: S/A/B/C/D/F on four pages, S/A+/A/B/C/D on M+ DPS (the documented A+) and S/A/B/C/D on M+ tank. All six titles self-identify Season 2 and the bodies agree. published re-read per page and unchanged, matching published-evidence/evidence.json 6/6: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 08-18, raid tank 08-14, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-18. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six, no value changed. Second run of 2026-08-21, so the snapshots were already stamped today and a same-day run cannot advance them.

The two brackets remain in different states. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 52-92 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__">. PARSER NOTE worth keeping: the tier lists live at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists, NOT page.tierLists - a first probe this run read the latter, got [] on all six, and would have reported the healthy M+ half as broken. Entries resolved from each entry's icon "Class-Spec" token, never the display name (Archon writes "BeastMastery Hunter"/"Blood DeathKnight"), and tiers[].entries is a list OF LISTS. M+ (metric "score"): 27/7/6 = 40 entries, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves - consistent with lastUpdated still reading 2026-08-20T12:00:00Z, i.e. upstream has not recut since this morning. RAID: all three tierLists (popularity, throughput, survivability) returned 0 entries, so no raid letters could be refreshed. WHAT CHANGED TONIGHT AND NEEDS THE OWNER: the raid pages have REBUILT FOR SEASON 2 in their chrome - encounterOptions is now the Venomous Abyss (Nek'zali, Sentinels, Vashnik, Explorers, Sszorak, The Twin Fangs, The Coiled Altar, Ula'tek, Nymrissa) and the description reads "tier list for The Venomous Abyss ... in 12.1" - while publishing zero tier entries. seasonVerified was DELIBERATELY left at s1 on the three raid pages. Reason: the 40 letters stored in ratings.raid.archon are Archon's SEASON-1 letters, and flipping the flag would make sourceSeasonOk true and average those S1 letters into the S2 raid consensus, which is exactly the two-seasons-in-one-number lie DECISION 1 exists to prevent; it would also publish a fabricated movement event tonight and a second, real one the day genuine S2 letters land. The flag gates the letters, and the letters are S1. Step 2's own rule also applies - with an empty DPS list there is no Devourer entry to era-verify against, so the ranking body is unverifiable, and "unverifiable -> skip, never guess". The correct flip is one run that replaces the letters and moves the flag together; that is the run the skill predicts will trip the anomaly gate and need a human anomaly_ack. M+ seasonVerified stays s2. No seasonVerified value changed anywhere this run, so freeze-season.mjs is a no-op.

NOT REFRESHED and the stored data was left byte-identical (619 tier rows across 9 Season-1 bosses + 8 Season-1 dungeons, top-level season stamp "s1", so the UI's Fight selector stays correctly hidden). Both registry URLs still address Season-1 content (.../tier-list/dps-rankings/raid/mythic/imperator and .../mythic-plus/10/windrunner-spire/this-week) and both are now RETIRED upstream: each returns HTTP 200 but 302s to Archon's game landing page - __NEXT_DATA__.page comes back as "/[gameSlug]" with no specTierListSection at all, which is why both fetches returned an identical 199,262-byte body. This is a URL retirement, not a parse failure and not a transport outage. URLs in sources.json are owner-only under Gate 0, so this run could not re-point them. FOR THE OWNER: the Season-2 encounter ids are enumerable from the aggregate pages' encounterOptions - bosses Nek'zali 3470, Sentinels 3445, Vashnik 3455, Explorers 3497, Sszorak 3420, The Twin Fangs 3421, The Coiled Altar 3429, Ula'tek 3492, Nymrissa 3379; dungeons Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena. Two things gate an actual rebuild beyond the URL edit: the S2 raid pages carry n=1-2 per spec (totalParses 0), so per-boss raid tiers would be noise, and an M+-only rewrite is 8 x 40 = 320 tier rows, under this requirement's 440-row floor. Rebuilding also means re-stamping the file's season to s2, which un-hides the Fight selector, so it should land as one reviewed change rather than piecemeal.

The survivability read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages, and those pages returned it EMPTY again tonight (0 entries) alongside throughput and popularity - the same Season-2 rebuild state described in the archon-tiers row, now with S2 encounter chrome but no published tiers. Pages fetched fine (HTTP 200, 52-62 KB, __NEXT_DATA__ parsed, specTierListSection.tierLists present with all three metrics listed and every one carrying zero entries), so this is an upstream no-data state and not a parse failure - proven on the same run by the M+ pages, where the identical code path returns 27/7/6. spec.survivability left untouched for all 40 specs. It clears when Archon publishes S2 raid survivability tiers, which needs real raid parses first.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" could not be honestly refreshed, and the standing-red note in required-sources.json needs one correction: it says the Season-2 raid pages return specRankingsSection.table.data EMPTY (0 rows). That is no longer true - tonight the raid DPS page returns 13 rows and the tank page 2, read from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[] as the recipe specifies, at lastUpdated 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z. But totalParses still reads 0 and EVERY row carries n = 1 or 2, so this is the first trickle of Season-2 logs, not a usable cut. Merged nothing, deliberately. Measured against stored (2026-08-16, n = 95-627 per row) the 13 rows would move Windwalker 171,021 -> 114,311, Arms 208,648 -> 133,283, Havoc 174,961 -> 140,373 and Balance 194,644 -> 151,922, and would shrink the series from 33 rows to 13 - straight through this requirement's 25-row floor and the 0.25 maxRowDropPct limit. The stored values are themselves Season-1 numbers dated 08-16 and stay put until Archon has real S2 raid parses. Do not ack this away and do not raise maxAgeDays; the red is the correct signal that the raid cut is stale, and it clears when totalParses moves off 0.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" is in the same state as archon-metrics and is reported separately rather than coupled to it, per the split-row rule. The Season-2 raid healer page's specRankingsSection now returns 4 rows (Preservation, Holy Paladin, Discipline, Restoration Shaman) where the contract note records 0, but totalParses is still 0 and all four carry n = 1. Merged nothing: the moves would be Preservation 214,368 -> 258,244, Restoration Shaman 235,814 -> 283,279, Holy Paladin 261,328 -> 255,669 and Discipline 209,115 -> 212,040 on a single parse each, and the series would drop from 7 rows to 4, under the 5-row floor. All 7 stored HPS values (2026-08-16, n = 250-390) left untouched. Clears with real S2 raid parses.

Fetched and fully parsed but nothing to merge: upstream has not recut since this morning's run. All three Season-2 M+ pages returned specRankingsSection.table.data at 27 + 7 + 6 = 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched, with page lastUpdated 2026-08-20T12:00:00Z and totalParses 950,129 / 316,669 / 316,628 - and every value AND every parse count matches stored exactly (Arms Warrior 2892 n=156,334; Restoration Shaman 2869 n=138,546; Blood Death Knight 2866 n=200,480; Devourer 2891 n=71,631, and so on for all 40). Recorded partial rather than success because the stored asOf legitimately stays at the source's own 2026-08-20 date: it is Archon's daily cut that has not advanced, not our fetch that failed. Nothing was written, so the data is byte-identical.

Half the series is fetchable and half is not, so the coverage date correctly does not move (the min-60th-freshest of 80 rows is a raid row at 2026-08-16). The 40 M+ Popularity rows re-parsed cleanly from the three Season-2 M+ pages and are IDENTICAL to stored at the 1-dp stored precision - each of the three role groups sums to 100.00%, no row equals that spec's DPS figure, so the shape check passes and there is simply nothing to write. The 40 RAID rows sit behind the same Season-2 rebuild as archon-metrics: only 13 DPS / 4 healer / 2 tank rows exist, each at n = 1-2 with totalParses 0, and their popularity values are shares of a 1-2 parse population (13 rows summing to 100%), which would be meaningless as a spec-popularity figure and would also delete 27 of the 40 stored raid rows. Merged nothing; all 80 stored rows byte-identical.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, no auth; the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and was not touched. manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z) and the rankings file's Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT AGREE, so this is not the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest shape where a frozen manifest hid a moving payload. The payload was diffed anyway rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined (whitelist, not a "dungeon" blacklist - melee and ranged are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs) gives 3 blocks and 27+7+6 = 40 rows, classSpec names matching the roster 40/40 with no mapping table. ALL 40 lowerBound values are identical to stored at the 1-dp stored precision. Genuinely frozen upstream, not a fetch failure - nothing to merge, so the coverage date correctly stays 2026-08-11. Owner-accepted standing red; it clears when WoWMeta re-runs its pipeline.

All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200. Sizes: curl reported 8.5-9.6 KB but that is the COMPRESSED body under --compressed - the real documents are 70,939 B (DPS) and ~62-63 KB (healer, tank), so this is not the empty-page shape it superficially resembles. 40/40 rows parsed from the meta-item blocks, 0 unmatched, counts reconciled at 27/7/6. NOTHING MERGED and the stored date correctly does not advance: all three pages carry <time datetime="2026-08-20T03:32Z"> (the DPS page 03:32:10Z, healer and tank 03:32:05Z) - the same cut this morning's run saw - and every one of the 40 "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" values matches stored exactly. Murlok states it updates every 8 hours, so a re-check tomorrow is expected to move; the page self-identifies "Midnight Season 2" throughout, with zero Season-1 mentions.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each. 17 specs return real data and the SAME 10 as the last two nights still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry - Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms, Fury - while the other 17 succeed interleaved in the same minutes, so the endpoint is demonstrably healthy and those specs simply have not been re-simmed. Every one of the 17 reads simc_settings.tier = MID2 (read off each chart, never hard-coded), ptr the string "0", target counts 1/2/3/4/5/6/8/9/15, and its OWN chart timestamp 2026-08-19. Stored is 26 profiles at MID1 dated 2026-07-08 (Elemental Shaman 07-15). MERGED NOTHING, and the reason is the tier gate rather than caution: a pool of 17 MID2 + 9 MID1 fails validate.mjs's uniformity check outright; fightLabels pools every DPS profile into one flat array with no provenance key, and MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1, so a partial merge would publish WHICH SPECS WERE RE-SIMMED as if it were spec strength; and "adopt what exists, null the rest" leaves 17 of 26, under the 19-row drop floor. Adopt MID2 wholesale or not at all - possible only when all 27 charts carry it, and it will need a human value_move_ack when it does (64 of 156 sim rows move more than 60%). asOf is the chart's own timestamp and was never stamped with the run date, so the coverage date honestly stays 2026-07-08 and the age gate going red IS the signal that upstream has not finished re-simming.

The standing recipe ran and the answer is unchanged, with one detail refreshed. MID1_Raid.txt is a 221-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no "DPS Ranking:" block (header: SimulationCraft 1210-01, 12.1.0.69404 Live, hotfix 2026-08-21/69404, git build HEAD 69a46e15b4), so the recipe falls through to MID1_Raid.html - which fetched fine at 37.2 MB and is still the 2026-08-08 report: SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live, hotfix 2026-08-06/68974, git build 678e66d384, Timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000. That is byte-for-byte the provenance of the 26 stored rows, so there is nothing to re-merge and an unchanged build hash is the honest explanation rather than a dressed-up fresh sim. MID2_Raid.txt was re-checked and remains not adoptable: 174,708 B, header 12.1.0.69382 PTR (hotfix 2026-08-20/69382, HEAD 69a46e15b4) where MID1's reads Live, and its "DPS Ranking:" block holds 33 profile lines covering only 17 distinct DPS specs plus 6 tank profiles against a 26-spec stored roster - a PTR-labelled partial run. Holding MID1 is the honest call and the red is the signal that upstream has not shipped a complete Live MID2. Merged nothing; all 26 rows byte-identical.

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), 302 -> /period/1077, HTTP 200, 210,929 B: the SAME period as the last three nights, still live and complete. Parse bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section and terminated at the next h2 - scanning the whole page yields 59 rows because the "Classes and specs" block and the per-dungeon sections repeat the same spec-image pattern. 40 li blocks -> 40 rows, 0 unmatched, labels normalised on [-\s]+ on both sides (they are lowercase-hyphenated, "devourer demon-hunter") and the value read as a bare number AFTER the img, so the bar's height:NN.NNNN% style cannot be mistaken for it. Shape-checked BEFORE comparing, which is the only thing that tells the share column from the /meta per-key-presence widget: the ingest sums to 100.40% with role subtotals DPS 60.3 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.1. Zero value moves against stored. Recorded success because the source was reachable, fully parsed and verified current, and its stored coverage date is today's - but note plainly that nothing was merged, since the weekly period has not rolled since this morning's run.

Three discovery channels plus the canonical forum thread swept, all healthy, and NO new build, hotfix or patch-notes entry landed - data/ptr-builds.json is unchanged at 19 entries. (1) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block, never by tag adjacency: HTTP 200, 112,515 B, 40 items, newest news=382560 at 2026-08-21 13:00 CDT; no class tuning in the window. (2) The news INDEX (data.news.newsData, anchored on the id attribute and brace-balanced from there) was polled as well because the index leads RSS within a run: totalPages 1540, 20 posts, top id 382560, identical head - nothing the RSS missed. (3) The Wowhead blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, 44 unique topics; the newest class-relevant item is Kaivax's running hotfix topic, whose title still reads "...Hotfixes - August 20". Verified against the canonical forum JSON rather than the mirror: us.forums topic 2336376 post 1 was last edited 2026-08-21T02:27:47Z and its date sections top out at August 20, 2026 - exactly the state this morning's run logged - while post 42 (Linxy, 2026-08-21T00:52Z) is that same August 20 section and post 40 (Kaivax, 2026-08-20T03:14Z) is August 19, both already in the feed. There is no August 21 section yet. The 12.1 development-notes thread 2317811 has posts_count 17 and last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42Z, newest post #19 - the closed cycle's expected silence, not a lost thread; the PTR zone sweeps stay dormant and get no rows. TWO blue posts were read in full and deliberately NOT logged, recorded so the next run does not re-litigate them: "Season 2 Class Tuning Plans" (Kaivax, us 2335871, 2026-08-12) names no spec and changes no value - it is the tuning CALENDAR (Aug 25 first week of S2 tuning, Sep 1 second, Sep 22 fifth, ~4 more before S3), and no kind value fits a schedule announcement; and "Item Adjustment Incoming - August 25" (Kaivax, us 2338382) is a single item change (Aqirbane Reliquary), out of the per-spec feed scope by the standing precedent. ACTIONABLE: expect a real tuning pass with the August 25 weekly maintenance. No set bonus was touched anywhere, so no spec.tierSet moved and the tier-set upkeep gate has nothing to pair. Spec writeup coverage recomputed rather than remembered: one spec lacks a ptr writeup, Demonology Warlock, whose null is the deliberate "source reported no changes" case.

Discovery complete and clean; distillation impossible - 0 takes and 0 metaNotes added and no creator latest advanced, so this half of the lane did not complete. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "ok" with requested 0 / fetched 0: not a credential problem, but because data/pending-transcripts.json videos[] was EMPTY when the deterministic step ran (this morning's run and the 2026-08-21 local run had drained it), so the step had nothing to fetch, and this agent holds no transcript credentials of its own. DISCOVERY: 44 unique YouTube channels polled (41 class-lane + 3 general), every one HTTP 200 on the first attempt, 0 feed errors, 660 entries. The seen-set was rebuilt from the four structured lanes - seen[] + skipped[] + videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url, never from log prose - and measured at 1,167 ids; 72 entries came back unseen. media:description was parsed alongside every title and did most of the triage: the unseen 72 are almost entirely launch-week stream VODs (bare-Twitch-link or streamlabs descriptions, key-run and raid-split POVs), which carry no spec-strength read under the standing guide-shaped and key-run rules and were left UNSEEN rather than retired, because an unverified shape dismissal is exactly what seen[] must not absorb. QUEUED 3, keyword-filtered as the nightly lane requires against Supadata's 100-request monthly budget: kGsd9cMmBCc (Supatease, "DISCOVERING THE BEST CLASSES 12.1", 08-18) to settle durably whether his "best classes" content is PvP-framed as the 08-09 precedent suggests; POENnO-sGog (Shadarek, Havoc DH delve boss kill, 08-20); 1LfW9JXNRsI (Harrek, Restoration Shaman delve solo, 08-19). RETIRED 6 ids to seen[] as durable SCOPE dismissals only: five explicitly PvP videos, out of scope for a PvE tracker by their own titles and descriptions (Supatease Ln9u8uDpP7E, BKpNGRtiDpc, KeiluPpDWCQ, DrleLy1u2dI and Dalaran Gaming jzNfwI-tr_g "5V5 1V1 DUELS"), plus MadSkillzzTV ELRklBVajH4, whose description states it is an EXBoss addon preview. yt-dlp was NOT usable and was not hammered: one metadata probe (--skip-download --print, no subtitle flags) hit the settled datacenter bot wall - "Sign in to confirm you are not a bot" - and the run stopped there rather than retrying, so live_status and duration could not be read and no Short or in-progress stream was retired on a measured fact. No creator showed coverage outside their registered specs, so nothing is flagged for a scope widening, and no supersession was needed because no take was added.
